newsitem.title: FRANCE: Dassault to have less than 25 pct of Aerospatiale.
newsitem.headline: Dassault to have less than 25 pct of Aerospatiale.

text.p: Serge Dassault, head of family-controlled combat plane maker Dassault Aviation, will have less than 25 percent of the merged Dassault Aviation-Aerospatiale, the French daily newspaper La Tribune said on Thursday.
Dassault is due to merge with plane maker Aerospatiale.
The newspaper said that Dassault would negotiate in April with government authorities over his part in the new merged group. His stake could end up being around 20 percent.
Newspaper reports have said that Dassault's stake in the future group will hinge on tax liabilities for the Dassault families on valuation of the two companies' assets.
Meanwhile, the newspaper said that President Jacques Chirac or Prime Minister Alain Juppe should announce an order for 48 Rafale Dassault fighter planes at the Le Bourget airshow in June.
